result: Expert-curated knowledgebase of human pathways; pathway summaries of release 97 read through reactome.org/ContentService on 2026-10-21. Glycolysis (R-HSA-70171): the entire process is cytosolic. Pentose phosphate pathway (R-HSA-71336, cytosol): generates a substantial fraction of the cytoplasmic NADPH and ribose 5-phosphate for nucleotide synthesis. Citric acid cycle (R-HSA-71403): all reactions take place in the mitochondrion. Mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation (R-HSA-77289): in the mitochondrial matrix after import by carnitine acyltransferases. Respiratory electron transport (R-HSA-611105): located in the inner mitochondrial membrane; the proton electrochemical gradient across it drives ATP synthase. SRP-dependent cotranslational protein targeting to membrane (R-HSA-1799339): the signal recognition particle binds the signal sequence of a nascent polypeptide and docks the ribosome complex with the SRP receptor on the ER membrane, where it passes to the translocon. Lysosome vesicle biogenesis (R-HSA-432720): the secretory pathway carries secreted proteins, resident proteins of the ER, Golgi and lysosomes and integral membrane proteins. Asparagine N-linked glycosylation (R-HSA-446203) and LLO biosynthesis (R-HSA-446193): N-glycans derive from a 14-sugar dolichol-linked precursor synthesised in the ER and are further modified in the Golgi compartments. Glycosphingolipid catabolism (R-HSA-9840310) and autophagy (R-HSA-9612973): endocytosed gangliosides and autophagic cargo are degraded in lysosomes; lack of an enzyme or cofactor causes sphingolipidoses including Gaucher and Niemann-Pick diseases. Peroxisomal lipid metabolism (R-HSA-390918), beta-oxidation of very long chain fatty acids (R-HSA-390247) and plasmalogen biosynthesis (R-HSA-75896): peroxisomal enzymes catabolise phytanate, pristanate and very-long-chain fatty acids and catalyse the first four steps of plasmalogen synthesis. mRNA splicing (R-HSA-72163, nucleoplasm) and transport of mature transcript to cytoplasm (R-HSA-72202): pre-mRNAs are capped, polyadenylated and spliced and processed mRNA is exported through the nuclear pore complex. Urea cycle (R-HSA-70635): carbamoyl phosphate is synthesised in mitochondria and cytosolic ARG1 is the canonical arginase. Gluconeogenesis (R-HSA-70263): converts mitochondrial pyruvate to cytosolic glucose 6-phosphate. PIP3 activates AKT signaling (R-HSA-1257604): PI3K converts PIP2 to PIP3, which recruits AKT to the plasma membrane, where TORC2 phosphorylates a serine and PDPK1 a threonine of AKT.
